title: Gemma 4 语音编码器冻结权重下的沙特与海湾阿拉伯语识别研究
summary: 研究 Gemma 4 共享的 3.05 亿参数音频编码器在沙特与海湾阿拉伯语识别中的表现：冻结编码器仅训练 2260 万参数 CTC 读取器，适配器版本增加 310 万低秩参数与混合 CTC/注意力读取器。适配系统在多个测试集上 WER 与商业模型相当或更优，CPU 上快 3.4 倍，单 GPU 达 139 倍实时。
summary_en: Studies the 305M-parameter audio encoder shared by Gemma 4 for Saudi and Gulf Arabic ASR without changing its weights. A frozen system trains only a 22.6M CTC reader; an adapted system adds 3.1M low-rank adapters and a hybrid CTC/attention reader. The adapted system matches or beats commercial and fine-tuned baselines on several sets, runs 3.4x faster on CPU, and 139x real time on one GPU.
